The securities report states that, in light of this accident, it will continue to respond sincerely to those who were affected. entries.1275ed93b2e16c99: This category operates hotels classified under the real estate business segment and is represented by JR West Hotel Development Co., Ltd. and Wakayama Terminal Building Co., Ltd. According to its history, in July 2025 JR West Hotel Development Co., Ltd. merged with Hotel Granvia Hiroshima Co., Ltd., Hotel Granvia Okayama Co., Ltd. and Nara Hotel Co., Ltd., and in October of the same year Hotel Granvia Osaka Co., Ltd. was also merged. The securities report explains that it captured demand from the Osaka-Kansai Expo and inbound tourism, and reorganized its hotel operating companies. The limited-service hotel 'Via Inn' is classified not in this category but in the Distribution Business segment. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.1793c4505cbbcb78: Real Estate Sales and Leasing Business
entries.17960dd3cbb0dbc9: This was one of the beginnings of group management, in which businesses other than railways were separated into subsidiaries to be carried out. The companies responsible for station retail and food services currently belong to the Retail segment, and retail sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥232,641 million.
entries.17ad3ec316f5c813: This reportable segment engages in real estate sales and leasing using owned properties, as well as shopping center operation and hotel operation. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥285,762 million (up 22.8% year on year), the 2nd largest among the reportable segments; segment profit was ¥46,332 million, segment assets were ¥1,026,302 million, and capital expenditure was ¥82.5 billion. The securities report explains that operating revenue rose 22.8% year on year to ¥285.7 billion and operating income rose 19.1% to ¥46.3 billion, due to strong performance in the shopping center and hotel businesses from the opening effects of urban development projects around Osaka Station and Hiroshima Station, and the expansion of real estate sales and leasing. Segment assets are the second largest after those of the Mobility Business.
entries.1b6f20ab3a1dfc52: The railway business operated by the company (the filing company). In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the route length was 937.7 km for Shinkansen and 3,959.8 km for conventional lines, totaling 4,897.5 km, and in addition there is a Type III railway business route length of 28.0 km (not included in the total). Passengers carried totaled 1,807,990 thousand (commuter pass 1,079,125 thousand, non-commuter pass 728,864 thousand), passenger-kilometers were 56,966,779 thousand passenger-km, and passenger transportation revenue was ¥947,964 million (106.2% of the previous fiscal year); total revenue including railway track usage fees and miscellaneous transportation revenue was ¥1,023,435 million. The main related companies in this category are, besides the company, Sagano Scenic Railway Co., Ltd., Kansai Rapid Railway Co., Ltd. and Osaka Outer Loop Railway Co., Ltd., the latter 2 of which are equity-method affiliates.
entries.1dd60a0228e01509: A reportable segment that, in addition to passenger transportation centered on the railway business, engages in station operations, cleaning and maintenance, construction, machinery and equipment works, rolling stock and equipment works, electrical works and more.

entries.2880ac0c1b83f71e: This is one of the lines supporting urban transport in the Keihanshin area. The JR Tozai Line is leased from Kansai Rapid Railway Co., Ltd. and operated, and under agreements with that company and other arrangements, the costs required for construction, ownership, and management are to be paid as track usage fees 4 times a year over 30 years. The lease period runs through fiscal 2026, and the track usage fees from the 31st year onward are to be determined through consultation.

entries.394663b43882428b: In March 2025, it transferred all of the shares of JR West Linen Co., Ltd. to Tetsudo Linen Service Co., Ltd. and excluded it from the scope of consolidation. In April 2025, it transferred the accommodation-specialized hotel business of JR West Daily Service Net Co., Ltd. to JR West Via Inn Co., Ltd. through an absorption-type company split. In July 2025, JR West Hotel Development Co., Ltd. merged Hotel Granvia Hiroshima Co., Ltd., Hotel Granvia Okayama Co., Ltd., and Nara Hotel Co., Ltd., and in October of the same year it also merged Hotel Granvia Osaka Co., Ltd.
entries.39a5dac007b17c37: This is a reportable segment engaged in passenger transportation centered on railway operations, as well as station operations and other operating businesses, cleaning and maintenance, construction, machinery and other equipment construction, rolling stock and other equipment construction, and electrical construction. In the railway business, the company operates over a wide area covering 2 urban prefectures and 16 prefectures in the Hokuriku, Kinki, Chugoku and northern Kyushu regions, providing intercity transportation centered on Shinkansen and limited express services on conventional lines, and urban-area transportation centered on the Keihanshin metropolitan area and regional core cities such as Hiroshima and Okayama. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥1,105,693 million, accounting for about 6-tenths of consolidated operating revenue of ¥1,845,840 million and making it the largest segment, with segment profit of ¥130,920 million, segment assets of ¥2,400,454 million, and capital investment of ¥196.1 billion. The annual securities report explains that transportation revenue increased because domestic demand remained firm even after the Expo, in addition to the Osaka-Kansai Expo and inbound demand, resulting in operating revenue of ¥1,105.6 billion, up 5.6% from the previous fiscal year, and operating profit of ¥130.9 billion, up 6.9%. The group also has 5 companies as units of management control — "Railway," "Sales of Goods and Food Services," "Hotels," "Shopping Centers (SC)" and "Real Estate" — which are a classification separate from the reportable segments.
entries.39dd22efbcda3198: This category is operated by group companies in passenger bus transport (JR Bus Chugoku Co., Ltd., West Japan JR Bus Co., Ltd.), ship operation (JR West Miyajima Ferry Co., Ltd.) and car rental and leasing (JR West Rent-a-Car & Lease Co., Ltd.).
entries.3c73de52aca06fe9: Real Estate Investment and Management Business
entries.3d208e55fb8a1ef5: This was a milestone at which the operation of the Hokuriku Shinkansen, which began in 2015, extended to Tsuruga, and the company came to operate the 293.7 km between Joetsumyoko and Tsuruga. The company's Shinkansen passenger revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥548,260 million (107.6% compared with the previous fiscal year), and the securities report explains that transport revenue in the Mobility business increased due to the Osaka-Kansai Expo, inbound demand, and domestic demand that remained firm even after the Expo.
entries.3fa2a05bad0a6efc: This is Shinkansen passenger transport. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, track distance was 937.7 km, passenger car-kilometers were 616,193 thousand km (101.8% of the previous fiscal year), passenger-kilometers were 23,092,478 thousand passenger-km (106.4%), and passenger revenue was ¥548,260 million (107.6%), of which non-commuter revenue of ¥533,638 million accounted for the great majority. The occupancy rate (passenger-kilometers divided by the product of passenger car-kilometers and average passenger capacity per car) was 48.1%, up from 46.0% in the previous fiscal year. The securities report explains that Shinkansen transport revenue rose 7.6% year on year, an increase of ¥38.8 billion to ¥548.2 billion, and that Shinkansen revenue depends mainly on the number of business and tourist travelers and is affected by the economic environment, competition with airlines and trends in inbound tourists. On safety, the company is extending seismic reinforcement and derailment prevention measures for the Sanyo Shinkansen to the entire line, and aims to complete the main measures by the end of fiscal 2027.
entries.40ab7fdd6f5fd895: This was a milestone at which all of the shares held by the agency tracing its origins to JNR were sold and it became a fully private company.
entries.41041d3dd59b059c: This shows that the appearance of the lines it operates has changed through both abolitions and new openings. The securities report states that revenue on local lines is affected by competition with private automobiles, regional economic conditions, and population trends. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, passenger revenue on conventional lines was ¥318,012 million in the Kinki area and ¥81,691 million for "Other" outside that area.
entries.412360c5dd6001b1: Transferred the automobile business and established companies responsible for station retail and food services
entries.49ec64adaf892508: In June 1949, Japanese National Railways (JNR) was established as a public corporation under the Japanese National Railways Act, and during the JNR era, operations began on the Sanyo Shinkansen between Shin-Osaka Station and Okayama Station (180.3 km) in March 1972 and between Okayama Station and Hakata Station (465.3 km) in March 1975.
entries.5002f6cea36ca382: In December 2001, the Act Partially Amending the Act Concerning Passenger Railway Companies and Japan Freight Railway Company came into effect, and the company was excluded from the scope of application of the "JR Companies Act." In March 2004, the 634,344 shares of the company held by the Japan Railway Construction, Transport and Technology Agency were sold, and full privatization was achieved.
entries.51a030b2cdedf849: This reportable segment engages in retail and food and beverage sales, department store operation, and wholesale of various goods.
entries.5480cd00a63e71e6: This was the milestone when operations began on the Osaka Higashi Line, which runs from Shin-Osaka Station to Kyuhoji Station.
entries.582a347b4a53b2ed: This was one of the beginnings of group management, in which businesses other than railways were separated into subsidiaries to be carried out.
entries.58c2a69ac3fe3df1: This was a milestone at which a company separated from JNR became a company whose shares are traded on the market. In April 2022, due to the review of the Tokyo Stock Exchange's market segments, it transitioned from the First Section to the Prime Market, and the cover lists the listed financial instruments exchange as the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market.
entries.59d1971aed9d5c16: The Shinkansen is now the center of revenue for the company's railway business. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company's Shinkansen passenger revenue was ¥548,260 million, accounting for more than half of the railway business's passenger transport revenue of ¥947,964 million. The securities report states that it will expand earthquake countermeasures to the entire Sanyo Shinkansen line and aims to complete the countermeasures by the end of fiscal 2052, and expects development costs of about ¥300 billion over 30 years.
entries.5dc6766d301f9ee4: In October 1996, it listed its shares on the First Section of the markets of the Osaka, Tokyo, and Nagoya stock exchanges and on the Kyoto, Hiroshima, and Fukuoka stock exchanges. Of these, Osaka integrated its market with the Tokyo Stock Exchange on July 16, 2013, Kyoto merged with the Osaka Securities Exchange on March 1, 2001, and Hiroshima merged with the Tokyo Stock Exchange on March 1, 2000, respectively.
entries.5deb985d7d42a17f: This category operates shopping centers such as station buildings and is carried out by JR West SC Development Co., Ltd., JR West Kyoto SC Development Co., Ltd., Toyama Terminal Building Co., Ltd., Sanyo SC Development Co., Ltd., Kanazawa Terminal Development Co., Ltd., JR West Urban Development Co., Ltd., Chugoku SC Development Co., Ltd., Wakayama Station Building Co., Ltd., Shin-Osaka Station Store Co., Ltd., JR West Osaka Development Co., Ltd., JR West Sanin Development Co., Ltd., and others.

entries.644b70126056ff7c: This category is operated by group companies in passenger bus transport (JR Bus Chugoku Co., Ltd., West Japan JR Bus Co., Ltd.), ship operation (JR West Miyajima Ferry Co., Ltd.) and car rental and leasing (JR West Rent-a-Car & Lease Co., Ltd.). According to its history, in April 1988 the bus business was transferred to West Japan JR Bus Co., Ltd. and Chugoku JR Bus Co., Ltd. (now JR Bus Chugoku Co., Ltd.), and in April 2009 the ship business was transferred to JR West Miyajima Ferry Co., Ltd. In July 2009, two station rental car companies merged to become JR West Rent-a-Car & Lease Co., Ltd. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.667d6ba03a93a67e: In March 2015, it began operations on the Hokuriku Shinkansen between Joetsumyoko Station and Kanazawa Station (168.6 km) and abolished the section of the Hokuriku Main Line between Naoetsu Station and Kanazawa Station (177.2 km).
entries.66877b8de5f98ff4: This category operates shopping centers such as station buildings and is carried out by JR West SC Development Co., Ltd., JR West Kyoto SC Development Co., Ltd., Toyama Terminal Building Co., Ltd., Sanyo SC Development Co., Ltd., Kanazawa Terminal Development Co., Ltd., JR West Urban Development Co., Ltd., Chugoku SC Development Co., Ltd., Wakayama Station Building Co., Ltd., Shin-Osaka Station Store Co., Ltd., JR West Osaka Development Co., Ltd., JR West Sanin Development Co., Ltd., and others. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, it opened 'Kitasenri Green Place' in July, and worked on the stable operation of 'Umekita Green Place', opened in the previous fiscal year, and 'minamoa' at Hiroshima Station. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.69cf52608706c5b5: This reportable segment engages in retail and food and beverage sales, department store operation, and wholesale of various goods. The business details table also lists the limited-service hotel 'Via Inn' (hotel business) within this category. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥232,641 million (up 11.7% year on year), segment profit was ¥16,264 million, segment assets were ¥111,704 million, and capital expenditure was ¥3.6 billion. The securities report explains that operating revenue rose 11.7% year on year to ¥232.6 billion and operating income rose 17.6% to ¥16.2 billion, due to strong performance from the opening of stores at the Osaka-Kansai Expo Official Store, station stores, and use of 'Via Inn'.
entries.6a4aad4800eda0bb: Transitioned to the Prime Market and became a company with an Audit and Supervisory Committee.
entries.6ac30543a1c697c9: Took over the railway facilities of the Sanyo Shinkansen and established a real estate company
entries.6c6001a80eff0229: This is an event that the securities report cites as a "reorganization of hotel operating companies" among the initiatives in the Real Estate business in the fiscal year ended March 2026. Hotels are listed in the table on the content of business divided so that the accommodation-specialized "Via Inn" is in the Retail business and the others are in the Real Estate business. Sales of the Real Estate business to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥285,762 million (an increase of 22.8% from the previous fiscal year), and the securities report explains that the shopping center business and the hotel business performed well.
entries.6ddca1157f3427e4: In October 1991, it took over the railway facilities of the Sanyo Shinkansen (excluding rolling stock) from the Shinkansen Holding Corporation (now the Japan Railway Construction, Transport and Technology Agency). Earlier, in June 1991, it established JR West Real Estate Co., Ltd. (now JR West Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.).
entries.6e8ec2795017388e: This category operates the limited-service hotel 'Via Inn' and is carried out by JR West Via Inn Co., Ltd.; the securities report classifies it under the Distribution Business segment.
entries.71285e25855f584f: In March 2024, it began operations on the Hokuriku Shinkansen between Kanazawa Station and Tsuruga Station (125.1 km) and abolished the section of the Hokuriku Main Line between Kanazawa Station and Tsuruga Station (130.7 km).
entries.7347365e88c093b3: This is the category the filing describes as a business segment not included in reportable segments, and it includes advertising and other businesses.
entries.781564d641efde66: This was the year in which the current listing segment (Prime Market), the form of the board of directors (a company with an Audit and Supervisory Committee), and the on-site organization by general headquarters, for Kinki, Chugoku, and the Sanyo Shinkansen, were all determined.
entries.7a45317cf8ddfb86: In June 1949, Japanese National Railways (JNR) was established as a public corporation under the Japanese National Railways Act, and during the JNR era, operations began on the Sanyo Shinkansen between Shin-Osaka Station and Okayama Station (180.3 km) in March 1972 and between Okayama Station and Hakata Station (465.3 km) in March 1975. In December 1986, the 8 laws related to JNR reform were promulgated, and in April 1987 the Japanese National Railways Act was abolished and 6 passenger railway companies, for Hokkaido, East Japan, Central Japan, West Japan, Shikoku, and Kyushu, and Japan Freight Railway Company were established. The company is one of the passenger railway companies established at that time.
entries.7a5b235fd06c335f: A railway company that runs Shinkansen and conventional lines in Hokuriku, Kinki, Chugoku and northern Kyushu, and also handles station buildings, shopping centers, hotels, department stores and travel agency business.
entries.7df4ad89398ac02c: In April 2018, it abolished the Sanko Line (108.1 km).
entries.827a3f8b0249a172: This category is carried out by JR West Isetan Co., Ltd.
entries.82b2e5c7159b5635: This category operates the limited-service hotel 'Via Inn' and is carried out by JR West Via Inn Co., Ltd.; the securities report classifies it under the Distribution Business segment. According to its history, in April 2025 the limited-service hotel business of JR West Daily Service Net Co., Ltd. was succeeded to it through an absorption-type company split. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, it renovated the guest room interiors of Via Inn Shinagawa Oimachi and worked to improve its competitiveness. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.882326507cc1fe89: The Osaka Higashi Line between Shin-Osaka and Hanaten opened
entries.894be40a7a8c194a: In June 1994, operations began between Hineno Station and Kansai Airport Station on the Kansai Airport Line (11.1 km), and in March 1997 between Kyobashi Station and Amagasaki Station on the JR Tozai Line (12.5 km).
entries.89651c09e13a963c: In November 1989, it began operating a general travel business (Minister of Transport Registration No. 921). Subsequently, in October 1990 it established JR West Hotel Development Co., Ltd. (now a consolidated subsidiary), and in November of the same year it established Sagano Scenic Railway Co., Ltd. (now a consolidated subsidiary).
entries.9168ab98c036b433: This category consists of group companies responsible for the construction and maintenance of facilities that support railway operations. The business details table lists rolling stock and other equipment installation (JR West Techno Co., Ltd., JR West Shinkansen Techno Co., Ltd.), machinery and other equipment installation (JR West Techsia Co., Ltd.), electrical work (JR West Electric Tech Co., Ltd., JR West Electric System Co., Ltd., Tetsuden Co., Ltd.), cleaning and maintenance (JR West Mentec Co., Ltd., JR West Chugoku Mentec Co., Ltd., JR West Kanazawa Mentec Co., Ltd.), and construction (Daitetsu Kogyo Co., Ltd., JR West Rail Tech Co., Ltd., JR West Built Co., Ltd., Kosei Construction Co., Ltd.). Kosei Construction Co., Ltd. is an equity-method affiliate. Tetsuden Co., Ltd. changed its trade name to T-SoLinx Co., Ltd. on June 1, 2026. In addition, JR West Customer Relations Co., Ltd., JR West Transport Service Co., Ltd. and JR West Chugoku Transport Service Co., Ltd., which are listed under 'Other' in the table, are also listed among the main related companies of the Mobility Business. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.9505259ce913287a: This is the origin of the group positioning the provision of safe and reliable transport services, with railways as its core business, as its most important task. The securities report explains that it has set out in its basic management policy its determination never to cause a serious accident such as the Fukuchiyama Line train accident, confirmed its initiatives in light of the "perspectives essential to realizing safety," which are lessons from the accident, and formulated the "Safety Action Plan 2027" in March 2023. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, it began using platform fences on some platforms at stations including Kyoto Station, Kobe Station, and Tennoji Station.
entries.9572a95a5b509d8c: In April 2022, due to the review of the Tokyo Stock Exchange's market segments, it transitioned from the First Section to the Prime Market. In June 2022, it transitioned to a company with an Audit and Supervisory Committee. In October 2022, it established the Chugoku General Headquarters and the Sanyo Shinkansen General Headquarters and abolished the Fukuchiyama Branch; it reorganized the Kyoto (now Keiji), Osaka (now Hanna), Kobe (now Hyogo), and Wakayama branches into the Kinki General Headquarters, the Hiroshima, Okayama, and Yonago (now San'in) branches into the Chugoku General Headquarters, and the Fukuoka Branch into the Sanyo Shinkansen General Headquarters.
entries.977651dfe36ff7c5: This category engages in real estate sales and leasing; the business details table lists real estate sales and leasing business (the company, JR West Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., JR West Properties Co., Ltd.) and real estate leasing business (Kyoto Station Building Development Co., Ltd., JR West Station City Co., Ltd.). The securities report explains that, in addition to business promotion in Japan, it worked on developing multi-unit rental housing in Houston, Texas, United States, and Sydney, Australia. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.9b50893aa70b05be: This is passenger transport on conventional lines, which the securities report presents divided into the 'Kinki Area' and the 'Other' area. The Kinki Area comprises southern Kyoto Prefecture, Osaka Prefecture (excluding some areas), southern Hyogo Prefecture, Shiga Prefecture, Nara Prefecture (excluding some areas) and part of Mie Prefecture. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, track distance was 3,959.8 km, passenger-kilometers totaled 33,874,300 thousand passenger-km (Kinki Area 27,607,236 thousand passenger-km; Other 6,267,064 thousand passenger-km), and passenger revenue totaled ¥399,703 million (104.3% of the previous fiscal year), of which the Kinki Area accounted for ¥318,012 million and the Other area for ¥81,691 million. The occupancy rate was 37.0%. The securities report explains that conventional line transport revenue rose 4.3% year on year, an increase of ¥16.4 billion to ¥399.7 billion, and that Kinki Area revenue is affected by economic conditions, changes in work styles, and population trends including the declining birthrate, aging population and urbanization, while local line revenue is affected by competition with private cars, regional economic conditions and population trends. In March 2026, Tedoriyama Heiwa Koen Station opened between Himeji Station and Aboshi Station on the Sanyo Main Line.
entries.9b7a3fcc635cfb4e: A train accident occurred on the Fukuchiyama Line
entries.a1d9be422a481240: This reportable segment engages in travel agency operations and in proposing solutions to regional issues, and its main related company is Nippon Travel Agency Co., Ltd. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥189,203 million (up 0.2% year on year), segment profit was ¥529 million (¥1,133 million in the previous fiscal year), segment assets were ¥86,578 million, and capital expenditure was ¥700 million. The securities report explains that although the solutions business performed well and operating revenue rose 0.2% year on year to ¥189.2 billion, operating income fell 53.3% to ¥500 million due to increased costs, among other factors. It also worked on expanding content and strengthening sales of the travel plan 'tabiwa Travel', offered within the company's app.
entries.a1f4e0529ac52909: In December 2001, the Act Partially Amending the Act Concerning Passenger Railway Companies and Japan Freight Railway Company came into effect, and the company was excluded from the scope of application of the "JR Companies Act."
entries.a530ba75188af239: In April 2018, it abolished the Sanko Line (108.1 km). The history also lists the abolition, between 1987 and 1990, of the Shigaraki Line (14.8 km), the Gannichi Line (32.7 km), the Wakasa Line (19.2 km), the Noto Line (61.1 km), the Taisha Line (7.5 km), the Kajiya Line (13.2 km), and the Miyazu Line (84.0 km), the section of the Kabe Line between Kabe Station and Sandankyo Station in December 2003 (46.2 km), and the Toyama Port Line in March 2006 (8.0 km). On the other hand, in March 2017 it began operations on the section of the Kabe Line between Kabe Station and Aki-Kameyama Station (1.6 km).
entries.a842c5dc842f4542: In October 2001, it transferred the travel business (excluding operations specific to railway operators and the like) to Nippon Travel Agency Co., Ltd. (now a consolidated subsidiary), and in December 2002 it underwrote that company's third-party allotment capital increase and made it a consolidated subsidiary.
entries.a8663d2c34997801: Passenger transport revenue from Shinkansen and conventional lines (commuter and non-commuter)
entries.a8b0c9f3e42fbbdb: This category is carried out by JR West Trading Co., Ltd. According to its history, it is the entity formed after merging with JR West Finance Co., Ltd. in April 2009. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.

In the table of business descriptions, the category lists advertising (JR West Communications Co., Ltd.), civil engineering and architectural consulting (JR West Consultants Co., Ltd.), spatial information consulting (Asia Air Survey Co., Ltd.) and information services (JR West IT Solutions Co., Ltd. and Railway Information Systems Co., Ltd.), among others, and Asia Air Survey Co., Ltd. and Railway Information Systems Co., Ltd. are equity-method affiliates. Because it is not a reportable segment, it is placed last rather than in order of revenue.
entries.aa630f69e4d0d830: This was the milestone when operations began on the Osaka Higashi Line, which is operated from Shin-Osaka Station to Kyuhoji Station. The table of facilities lists the section between Shin-Osaka and Kyuhoji as 20.2 km, and the company operates it under lease from Osaka Gai Kanjo Tetsudo Co., Ltd. Under the agreement and other arrangements with that company, the company is to pay the costs required for construction, ownership and management as a track usage fee over 43 years, 1 time each year, in an annual amount of ¥2,140 million.
entries.ab1efed69d2f4c59: The Shinkansen is now the center of revenue for the company's railway business.

entries.b3ce3770556550ad: In March 2008, it began operations between Hanaten Station and Kyuhoji Station on the Osaka Higashi Line (9.2 km), and in March 2019 between Shin-Osaka Station and Hanaten Station (11.1 km).

The current group operates, in addition to the Mobility business centered on railways, the Retail business, the Real Estate business, and the Travel and Regional Solutions business, and consolidated operating revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,845,840 million.

entries.b8bff9f72db1d9e2: In October 1991, it took over the railway facilities of the Sanyo Shinkansen (excluding rolling stock) from the Shinkansen Holding Corporation (now the Japan Railway Construction, Transport and Technology Agency).
entries.b9dd9dd0f06bd3cc: This category is carried out by JR West Isetan Co., Ltd. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.

entries.ed9194bbc9a41d57: This was an event in which the travel business was moved to a specialized company. Nippon Travel Agency Co., Ltd. is currently a major affiliated company in the Travel and Regional Solutions segment, and that segment's sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥189,203 million.
entries.f43b40ec196e7f7d: This was a milestone at which the Hokuriku Shinkansen was added to the Shinkansen lines operated by the company. The Hokuriku Shinkansen (293.7 km between Joetsumyoko and Tsuruga) is leased from the Japan Railway Construction, Transport and Technology Agency and operated, and lease fees are to be paid 4 times a year over 30 years from the lease. The lease period runs through fiscal 2044 for the section between Joetsumyoko and Kanazawa and through fiscal 2053 for the section between Kanazawa and Tsuruga.
